title: Emod algorithm body
statement: The algorithm sets `Rest` to the absolute value of `Arg`, using truncated subtraction from zero when `Arg` is negative; it sets `Count` to zero and `Mult` to `Modulus`, then runs the table loop, the reduction loop, and the sign adjustment in sequence.
caveat: The payload omits the definitions of the Emod variables and arithmetic-expression notation, so their intended meanings are inferred from their names and use.
